description: Source code for the ApplicationPage class in Apache Spark's master UI module, responsible for rendering application details and executor information in the web UI.

classes.name: ApplicationPage
classes.description: Web UI page class for displaying details of a specific Spark application, including executor info and application metadata.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates HTML content for the application details page, including application info and executor summaries.

methods.name: executorRow
methods.description: Creates a table row for an executor, displaying its ID, worker, resources, state, and logs.
